claim_boundary: Planner-quality infrastructure evidence only. This does not claim a predicted-planner SQL execution win.
root_cause: Split preparation resolved CoSQL source rows from --source-root but left the repo-relative tables_path unresolved in fresh worktrees. Prepared rows therefore had database IDs and questions but no schema or semantic model context.
fix: Resolve repo-relative tables_path against --source-root before building split-based prepared rows.

before.description: Fresh-worktree prepared rows lacked schema context.

after.description: Fresh-worktree prepared rows include schema and semantic model context from tables.json.

interpretation: Schema context restoration fixes the table-linking blind spot: table F1 moves from 0.0 to 0.650 on proxy and 0.633 on clean holdout.
Column and projection-shape quality remain too weak for another predicted-planner SQL endpoint run.
The next Checkpoint 5 work should improve non-oracle column linking and selected-count/projection prediction before running eval.run_predicted_planner_comparison.
